events.title: Gamba Osaka vs Ratchaburi
events.dataContent:
Gamba Osaka vs Ratchaburi: Live Stream & Watch Online

Watch the live broadcast of this AFC Champions League Two fixture as Japan's Gamba Osaka host Thailand's Ratchaburi at Panasonic Stadium Suita. Hosts lead Group F with perfect 15 points (5 wins from 5, +12 GD), visitors sit 2nd with 9 points (3W-2L, +2 GD).

Kick-off: December 11, 2025, 13:00 MSK (10:00 UTC)
Stadium: Panasonic Stadium Suita, Suita, Osaka (capacity 39,694)
Competition: AFC Champions League Two, Group F

Gamba Osaka vs Ratchaburi: Match Preview

Gamba already secured top spot and comfortably won the previous encounter away at Ratchaburi 2-0, demonstrating class superiority. Ratchaburi followed that loss with consecutive wins over Nam Dinh (2-1) and Eastern (5-1), but the Japanese clash exposed the level gap.

Team Form and Analysis

Gamba Osaka

The Japanese side remain unbeaten in the tournament, averaging 2.7 goals scored and 0.9 conceded per game. They outperform opponents in all statistical categories: possession (60% vs 40%), passing accuracy (92% vs 84-86%), chance creation. This is the season's last home match, with the club eager to give their coach a proper send-off.

Ratchaburi

The Thai outfit average 2.6 goals scored and just 0.7 conceded per match, but couldn't execute their attacking potential against Gamba (0-2 loss). They showed excellent form against weaker opponents but lost both matches to stronger sides.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Gamba Osaka (4-2-3-1): Higashiguchi - Fukuoka, Miura, Watanabe, Noda - Usami, Fukuda - Kumagai, Onishi, Yoneyama - Mitsuta.
  • Ratchaburi (4-3-3): Santivipat - Limwannasathian, Yousef, Zhang, Corina - Srisuwan, Promrak, Yoryoei - Hummet, Jebali, Sorada.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Gamba Osaka are clear favorites at odds 1.37-1.65 with 55.7% win probability, while Ratchaburi have a 33.3% chance at 6.3-7.23 odds.

  • Main Prediction: Gamba Osaka to Win (1). Hosts with perfect 5/5 record should comfortably beat visitors again. Likely scoreline: 2-0 or 3-1.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals with 59.3% probability. 60% of Gamba's and 50% of Ratchaburi's matches exceed this mark.

Nam Dinh vs Eastern SC: Live Stream & Watch Online

Watch the live broadcast of this AFC Champions League Two fixture as Vietnam's Nam Dinh host Hong Kong's Eastern SC at Thien Truong Stadium. Hosts sit 3rd in Group F with 6 points (2W-3L, -2 GD), visitors bottom the table in 4th with 0 points (0W-5L, -19 GD).

Nam Dinh vs Eastern SC: Match Preview

Nam Dinh already beat Eastern 1-0 away in the first round but then suffered three consecutive defeats, clinging to slim playoff hopes. Eastern are hopeless bottom without a single point, losing their last two matches with an aggregate 0-12 scoreline (Ratchaburi 1-5 and Gamba Osaka 0-7).

Team Form and Analysis

Nam Dinh

The Vietnamese side started brilliantly with two wins (3-1 over Ratchaburi and 1-0 over Eastern) but then lost three straight with a combined 1-8 scoreline. At home they average 1.4 goals scored and 1.1 conceded per match. Attack leader: Brazilian forward Brenner (2 tournament goals).

Eastern SC

The Hong Kong club lost all 5 matches with a 2-21 aggregate, showing complete inability to compete at this level. Away they average 1.7 goals scored but concede the same amount, losing their last 8 matches without a single victory.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Nam Dinh (4-3-3): Nguyen Van Hoang - Le Van Do, Tran Dinh Hoang, Nguyen Thanh Chung, Nguyen Hai Huy - Dinh Thanh Binh, Ha Minh Tuan, Pham Xuan Manh - Hendrio, Brenner, Okubo.
  • Eastern (4-4-2): Lau Chun Lok - Wong, Kyabputti, Huang Yang, Hu - Novo, Jussi Kumpulainen, Pedro Miguel, Correia - Noah, Panayotou.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Nam Dinh are clear favorites at odds 1.06-1.08 with 54.5% win probability, while Eastern have just 22.3% chance at 30-32 odds.

  • Main Prediction: Nam Dinh to Win (1) with a big margin. Hosts should capitalize on visitors' catastrophic form for a comfortable victory. Prediction: 3-0.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals with 77.4% probability. Nam Dinh aim to maximize goal difference while Eastern concede heavily.

Pohang Steelers are obvious favorites at odds 1.21-1.22 with 70-80% win probability, Kaya has only 20% chance at odds 7.50-8.50.

  • Main Prediction: Pohang Steelers to Win (2). Koreans already beat the Filipinos 2-0 and should repeat the success. Likely score: 0-2 or 0-1.

Beijing Guoan vs Macarthur: Match Preview

Beijing Guoan just lifted the Chinese Cup, beating Henan 3-0 in the final on December 6th, ending a seven-year trophy drought thanks to Angolan forward Fabio Abreu's hat-trick. Macarthur lost the first head-to-head 0-2 in October, managing just 36% possession and only 3 shots on target against Beijing's 7.

Beijing Guoan

The Chinese side top the tournament statistics for duels won and average 2.8 goals per match (3.4 at home), showing excellent attacking form. Fabio Abreu is the Chinese Super League's top scorer this season and has 2 AFC goals.

Macarthur

The Australians struggle to create chances away from home, ranking last in the tournament for duels and averaging just 1.4 xG on the road. Group leaders: midfielder Serginho scored 2 goals in 3 matches.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Beijing Guoan (4-2-3-1): Hou Sen - Yang Fanyu, Memišević, Lin Liangming, Li Lei - Zhang Xiuwei, Wang Zizhen - Zhang Yuning, Chi Zhongguo, Cao Yongding - Abreu.
  • Macarthur (4-3-3): Kurz - Susnjar, Miranda, Milković, Vellman - Serginho, Milante, Hollman - Reynolds, Dávila, Jebour.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Beijing Guoan are favorites at odds 1.88-2.07 with 53.4% win probability, while Macarthur have a 33.3% chance at 3.28-3.80 odds.

  • Main Prediction: Beijing Guoan to Win (1). Hosts ride the momentum from their cup triumph and dominate duels, which is critical for home advantage. Likely scoreline: 2-1.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals with 68.9% probability. 100% of Beijing's home matches and 9 of last 10 games overall exceeded this mark.

Dinamo Zagreb vs Real Betis: Match Preview

Dinamo lost their last two Europa League matches, conceding 7 goals without scoring, but won 4 of their last 5 fixtures across all competitions. Betis remain the only team unbeaten away from home this season (5 wins, 6 draws in 11 matches), drawing with Genk (0-0) and beating Ludogorets (2-0) in the Europa League.

Dinamo Zagreb

The Croatians average 1.75 goals scored per home match with an average xG of 1.59, showing decent attacking prowess. They beat Fenerbahçe (3-1) at home but lost to Celta (0-3), while suffering from injuries: Torrente, Valinčić, Živković ruled out, Mikić doubtful. Leaders: Dario Ljubičić (2 goals), Duško Beljo (2 goals).

Real Betis

The Spaniards average 2.5 goals scored away with xG 1.92 and concede just 0.75, showcasing excellent defensive solidity. Their 8-match unbeaten streak was ended by Barcelona (3-5), but Betis haven't lost on the road once this season. Key players: Abde Ezzalzouli (2 goals), Antony (2 goals, 2 assists).

Celta de Vigo enters this match with a solid track record at home, where their passionate fans create an electrifying atmosphere. Their mix of youth and experience provides a balanced approach, making them a formidable opponent for any team.

Bologna, on the other hand, has been steadily improving in the Italian Serie A and seeks to carry that momentum into European competition. Known for their disciplined style and defensive organization, they will aim to frustrate Celta's attacking threats. Bologna's ability to execute quick counter-attacks has proven effective, particularly in high-pressure situations, making them dangerous on the road.

Tactical Analysis

Celta de Vigo

Celta de Vigo typically employs an aggressive style of play, utilizing the flanks to stretch the opposition. Their midfield operates with creativity and dynamism, aiming to control possession and dictate the pace of the game. Solid in attack with proficient ball movement, Celta will challenge Bologna's defense through incisive passing and runs behind the back line.

Bologna

Bologna usually adopts a more reserved approach, focusing on maintaining a compact defensive structure. Their midfielders play a key role in breaking up opposition plays, and they excel in transitioning from defense to attack. Quick breaks can catch the hosts off guard, and their forwards thrive on exploiting gaps left by opponents. However, they must ensure that they remain disciplined to withstand Celta's pressure.

Key Players to Watch

Celta de Vigo's attacking threats are complemented by their playmakers who bring creativity and vision. Their forwards possess speed and skill, making them a constant threat in the final third. Key leaders in the squad will be pivotal in guiding their teammates during this crucial encounter.

Bologna relies on their cohesive team structure, with several players standing out for their ability to transition quickly. Their defensive stalwarts provide stability, while agile forwards remain key in executing counter-attacks. Each player’s contribution will be vital in navigating this important European clash.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

This encounter is poised to be a competitive display between two teams with contrasting styles. Celta de Vigo's home advantage and attacking flair may give them the edge, but Bologna's organizational strength and strategic approach could level the playing field. Expect a tight match, with the potential for exciting moments as both teams vie for vital points.
